name: v1.4 minus Miami-Dade/Broward/Palm Beach; Panhandle as its own list
notes: Same weights, land screen, options and thresholds as v1.3. County-to-manager assignment read from the Feb 2026 7-Eleven team map by Claude (inferred where the map names regions, not counties). Polk kept from the pilot (east of US-27 is McDonald's). Bradford included whole (only east of US-301 is Bauer's). Wakulla, Taylor, Union, Hamilton and Lafayette are not named on the map and are left out. DeSoto left out for now: the DOR 2026 final tax roll (NAL) file for DeSoto is not posted on the DOR portal (checked 2026-11-23). Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach removed at Ross's request (their 7-Elevens still count for the 2-mile spacing). Panhandle = counties west of the Aucilla River (Claude's definition): Escambia, Santa Rosa, Okaloosa, Walton, Holmes, Washington, Bay, Jackson, Calhoun, Gulf, Gadsden, Liberty, Franklin, Leon, Jefferson; ranked on its own list.

scope_approved: Ross, 2026-11-23: run the model on all counties in the Golden, Bauer and Antonacci territories (Florida only); about 3x the pilot population, so a Top 150 instead of a Top 50. Ross, 2026-11-23 follow-up: Panhandle as its own tab outside the Top 150; remove Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach (ECP does not want to pursue them).
territory_source: 7-Eleven FL-Southeast Development Team Map, Feb 2026 (project file)
changes_line: 1. Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach are out (ECP isn't pursuing them); their 7-Elevens still count for the 2-mile spacing. 2. The Panhandle (Escambia east through Leon and Jefferson) is ranked on its own 'Panhandle' tab (P1, P2a...), outside the Top 150; most of it is 10+ miles from any 7-Eleven. 3. Everything else as the Nov 23 Top 150 (v1.4): 52 counties (incl. Polk) in Bauer's, Golden's and Antonacci's territories, up to 5 options per area ordered by best roads, highway plays listed separately.
extra_limits: • Panhandle tab: 7-Eleven has only 2 stores there in our data (Gadsden, Santa Rosa) and 1 recent sale in the tracker (Milton, 2026); the distance score gives full credit at 5+ miles, so its areas score high. • 'New market' flags areas 10+ miles from any 7-Eleven outside the Panhandle. • DeSoto is not included (no 2026 tax roll posted).
